༄༅/ /gaṇḍi'i rnam bzhag legs par bshad pa rta bdun rgyal po blo gsal yid kyi padmo kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ya

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gaṇḍi'i rnam bzhag legs par bshad pa rta bdun rgyal po blo gsal yid kyi padmo kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/rje btsun gong ma lnga dang / /brgyud par bcas ngor pa rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' chen po sogs pa'i bzhed bzhugs rgya mtsho yi/ /thun mong min pa'i dgongs pa 'grel mkhas pa'i/ /kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma rtag tu rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po yi/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba rnam dag dge 'dun sde/ /'phel zhing rgyas byed chos kyi gaṇḍi yi/ /rnam bshad rnam bdun rgyal po zhes bya 'di/ /'chad par 'gyur gyi mang thos dpyod ldan rnams/ /legs par ltos la legs bshad ri mor bris/ /rang gis rtogs nas gzhan la'ang spel bar mdzod/ /de ltar bgyis na don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /kye ma deng sang bstan pa'i sgo zhugs rnams/ /phal cher gzhung lugs ming tsam shes pas tshim/ /de phyir 'di la'ang gaṇḍi'i ming shes pas/ /chog par ma 'dzin rnams bshad 'di longs shig /de la 'dir gaṇḍi'i rnams dbye spyir bstan pa dang / de'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa/ de nyid bskul tshul gyi grangs la dgos pa'i mtha' gcad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdo rtsa bar/ bsdu ba'i phyir gaṇḍi brdung ngo / /de'i gnas ni kha steng ngo / dge 'dun bsdu ba'i phyir ni rgyud gsum dang de snyed kyi tog dag go /las bya ba'i don du ni rgyud gcig dang tog gsum mo/ /kha cig las ni rgyud gsum dang rtog gnyis so zhes so/ /shi ba la phrag pa dbyung ba'i don du byi bo'o/ /kha gcig las ni rgyud gcig dang tog gcig go zhes so/ /spong ba pa'i don du ni 'khar sil lo/ /kha gcig las ni gaṇḍi chung du zhes pa'o/ /gnod pa byung ba la ni ji tsam gyi chog pa'o/ /zas kyi phyir 'du ba'i don du ni gaṇḍi dang gaṇḍi chung ngu gnyis ka brdung ngo /

/bar du bcad de'o/ /'gyang bas so/ /'dus pa chen po'i tshe gaṇḍi brdungs pas go bar mi 'gyur ba na dung bsgrigs te 'bud par bya'o/ /rnga bo che dag brdung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid la dbye na lnga ste/ 'du ba'i gaṇḍi/ las kyi gaṇḍi/ spong ba'i gaṇḍi/ shi ba'i gaṇḍi/ bskrod pa'i gaṇḍi dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ chos dang bsnyen bskur sogs la 'du ba ste/ rgyud gsum dang tog gsum yin la/ rgyud gsum ni/ dang po gan g.yog shugs chung ngu nas bco brgyad kyi bar du je che je che brdeg cing / bcu dgu pa nas so lnga'i bar du je chung je chung brdeg pa tshar gcig ni rgyud gcig yin pas/ de 'dra ba tshar gsum ni rgyud gsum yin no/ /tog gsum ni shugs chen pos mtshams chod ngos shes pa lan gsum brdeg pa ste rgya nyag brgyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ las grwa sogs la 'du ba ste rgyud gsum dang tog gnyis yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dge slong gi dge 'dun bsam gtan la zhugs pa'i sgor 'khar sil khrog pa ste gaṇḍi'i sgrar gdags so/ /gzhan yang sil snyan dang / dung dang / 'khar rnga dang / rnga bo che rnams la yang gaṇḍi'i sgrar gdags par shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dge slong gi dge 'dun shi ba'am/ phung po 'don pa'i dus su rgyud gcig pu yin pas tog med do/ /lnga pa ni/ gnod pa byung ba'i dus yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chos mi mthun gyi bya ba chen po byas pa'am/ lo tog la gnod pa'i ser ba chen po sogs byung ba'i tshe'am/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi longs spyod dang bca' ba byas pa sogs la gnod pa'i dgra dang / chom rkun dang / ar po la sogs pa sprod par byed pa ste/ gaṇḍi de drag tu brdungs shing grangs nges pa med pa'o/ /gnyis pa gaṇḍi'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa la bcu gnyis te/ rgyu tshad dbyibs rdung bzhag pa'i gnas/ /brdung gnas rab gnas brdung ba'i tshul/

/brdung dus gang zag nyes dmigs dang / /phan yon dang ni bcu gnyis so/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po gaṇḍi'i rgyu ni/ gaṇḍi'i mdo las/ 'byor bar 'dod pa'i shing rnams ni/ /rab tu 'bad de brtag par bya/ /go shing sha tsandan shā la ṭu bil pa rgya skyed shing pa la sha/ /pi pi ling a shwa tha dang rakta tsandan tsandan dmar/ /a shwa ra rgya ltar ta la rwa tsa ta la keṃ shu ka /a gu ru pa sha pi shing dang ta ma la/ /tsu ri'i shing lcang go ra a smras ltar bu skyu ru ra/ /tanti pa ra mya ngan med pa'i a shwa ka /'di dag thams cad med na yang / /'o se la ni 'bad de bya/ /rgyal po 'bad pas thams cad du/ /'di dag med na mi bya 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tsandan dkar po sogs bcu drug la bya bar bshad pa'i 'o se la zhes pa'i shing 'di la mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi 'o ma se bya ba'i shing 'o ma can nam thang chu can gyi shing cig yin par bshad cing / yang 'ga' zhig ni seng ldeng yin par bshad cing / yig cha 'ga' zhig tu ni/ 'o se la zhes pa ma dag pas/ 'os sa la ni 'bad de bya/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ gong gi shing de rnams ma rnyed na shing ji ltar rigs pa la'ang rung ngo / /zhes 'byung ba yin la/ gnyis pa gaṇḍi'i tshad ni/ de nyid las/ tshad ni chung du sor tshad kyis/ /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi nyid bya zhing / /zheng du sor drug bya ba ste/ /dpangs su yang ni gnyis bya 'o/ /sor mo'i tshigs kyi tshad rnams ni/ /zur bzhi tshad ni gnyis pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ che tshad srid du sor brgya dang brgyad/ chung tshad brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ de'i bar ni 'bring tshad yin la/ gzhan yang spong ba'i gaṇḍi sor bcu gnyis dang / nyer bzhi pa sogs kyang bshad pa yin no/ /gsum pa dbyibs ni/ de nyid las/ legs nyams nyid dang shin tu gsal/ /rtse gnyis sbal pa'i mgo bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbyibs ni zheng du sor drug pa/ dpang du sor gnyis pa/ zur bzhir brgyad gzhogs sor gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/

rtse mo gnyis sbal pa'i mgo 'dra bar bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa rdung byed ni/ gaṇa g.yog kyang shing de nyid las bcad pa/ gaṇḍi la phog pa'i tshad la sor bcu gnyis/ lag pa gzung bar bya ba'i 'chang gzung gi tshad kyang de dang mnyam pa/ rtse gnyis ne'u le'i mgo 'dra bor bya ba yin te/ de nyid las/ de nas brdung bar byed pa yang / /shing de nyid las 'bad de bya/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dag la/ /'dum zhing rtse gnyis ne'u le'i mgo /'chang gzung tshad kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsung pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa bzhag pa'i gnas ni/ de nyis las/ gang zhig de brdung bzhag dgos pas/ /'og tu yang ni khri byas la/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgo steng ngam/ /yang na dbus ma'i steng du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtsug lag khang gi sgo steng ngam/ gtsug lag khang dbus ma'i steng du khri la bzhag par bya ba yin no/ /drug pa brdung ba'i gnas ni/ gtsug lag khang gi steng la sogs pa gaṇḍi'i sgra kun gyi thos pa'i gnas zhig tu bya ba yin no/ /bdun pa rab gnas ni/ chos sku skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi stong pa gdod ma nas ma skyes shing dge ba yum chen mor mos pa byas nas/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa ste/ de yi rab gnas bya ba ni/ /shin tu brtan par chos kyi sku/ /skye ba ma yin 'jig pa min/ /gdod nas ma skye par dge ba/ /de ltar rab gnas byas nas ni/ /de ni spyan dbye gyur pa yin/ /zhes dang / gleng gzhir yang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bcom ldan 'das la dug gsum gyi gnyen por zhus pa na/ de'i tshe'i yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gaṇḍi'i rnam par bzhugs/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na bzhugs khri dang na bza' la sogs pa gang gi sgo nas kyang gus par bya'i/ mi gus par bya ba ma yin no/ /brgyad pa ji ltar brdung ba'i tshul la/ spyir gong du bstan pa ltar brdung tshul mtha' yas kyang / dge 'dun 'jam tshul lta bu zas la 'du ba'i don du gaṇḍi chung ba rgyud gcig dang rtog gcig dang /

gaṇḍi che ba rgyud gsum tog gsum du brdung bar bya ba dang / yang dge 'dun chos nyan chos spyod sogs la 'du ba'i don du/ gaṇḍi chung ba rgyud gcig tog gcig pa/ spang ba'i che ba rgyud gsum tog gsum pa brdung ba ste/ de dag ji ltar ba'i tshul la gsum/ bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po bsam pa ni/ gaṇḍi yum chen mor mos pa dang / de brdungs ba la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba dang / gaṇḍi'i sgra la stong pa nyid pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi sgrar mos pa dang / bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i bsam pa sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ der 'gro dkon mchog gsum la ni/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni brdungs byas te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang du gaṇḍi brdung ba'i gnas su song ste/ dkon mchog la phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro bas brdung ba yin no/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi ni/ shangs tshal lan gsal brjod nas ni/ /chos kyi rnga rnams brdung bar bya/ /klu bdun gyis ni brgyan par ltar/ /bskyed pa'i rim gyis brdung bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar thog mar dge 'dun bsam gtan la gnas pa rnams la gaṇḍi'i sgra ches pas hong krog sogs mi 'byung ba'i phyir shangs tshal te/ gaṇa shud lan gsum byas la/ de nas bzhengs gaṇa nam/ gaṇa chung du grags pa'i rgyud gcig tog gcig pa'i brdung tshul ni/ gcig nas bco brgyad kyi bar je che je cher song ba dang / bcu dgu nas so lnga'i bar je chung che chung du byas la/ de nas tog sgra chen po gcig bya'o/ /gaṇa chung 'di dang gaṇa chen gyi bar du bgyangs bcad de yug gcig mi brdung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de'i bar la gaṇḍi bskul ba po rang gi so thar gyi mdo 'don pa'am/ mi shes na ltung bshags 'don pa dang / dge 'dun byin gyi yang bsam gtan sogs las bzhengs te ltung bshags 'don bzhin pa'i ngang nas lhung bzed sogs sta gon bya ba'i phyir du yin la/ de nas gaṇa chen bskul ba'i tshul la rgyud gsum tog gsum pa bya ste/

de yang gcig nas bcu bdun gyi bar je che je che dang / bco brgyad pa shin tu che ba gcig bya/ bcu dgu nas so lnga'i bar je chung du song ba ste/ de 'dra ba lan gsum la brgyud gsum zhes bya ba yin la/ de nas tog sgra chen po lan gsum bya ste/ de'i bar la dge 'dun rnams 'dus grub par bya'o/ /yang dge 'dun chos nyan la 'du ba la ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rgyud gsum tog gsum pa de nyid cung zad myur bar brdung ba yin la/ yang dge 'dun chos spyod la 'du ba la ni/ zas la 'du ba'i skabs bzhin gyi rgyud gsum du brdung bar bya ba las chos spyod chos nyan gnyis la bzheng gan nam/ gaṇa chung du grags pa'i rgyud gcig tog gcig pa de mi dgos so/ /yang dge 'dun chos mi mthun gyi bya ba chen po byas phyir dbyugs ba la ni/ dge 'dun byin gyis bzlog pa dang bstun/ gaṇḍi bskul ba'i las byed pas rgyud tog med par drag tu brdung ba ste/ tog med pa'i mchod rten la byi'o zer ba bzhin/ gong du bshad pa'i shi ba'i gaṇḍi la byi ro btags pa de nyid dang 'di cha 'dra ba yin no/ /yang gong du tog gcig dang tog gsum sogs bshad pa de rnams kyang mchod rten gyi tog dang 'dra bas na de dang 'dra ba ming btags pa yin par bshad do/ /dgu pa brdung ba'i dus ni/ de nyid las/ zan za nyi ma 'char nub tshe/ /dus gsum la ni lan gsum ste/ /sku khrus tshe na lan gsum bsngags/ /glo bur gnod pa char mi 'bab/ /de ni 'thab dang rtsod pa dang / /klog dang gnod pa chen po dang / /nad dang mu ge zhi bya'i phyir/ /ma 'chol rim gyis brdung bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar nam skabs su babs pa'i tshe brdung bar bya'o/ /bcu pa brdung ba po'i gang zag ni/ de nyid las/ dge slong rnams dang dge tshul gyi/ /dus rnams brtag tu brdung bya ste/ /gso sbyong la ni gnas pa'i tshe/ /dge bsnyen gyis kyang brdung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dge bsnyen gtsang ma yan chad kyi brdung bar bya ste/

de yang chos phyogs pa ste/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta spyod dang ldan pas brdung / chos mi phyogs pa ste/ mu stegs pa'i lta spyod dang ldan pas mi brdung / rdzu 'phrul gyi stag la sogs pa'i gzugs su ma bsgyur ba'i lus tha mal par gnas pa dang / smyo ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i bsam pa rang bzhin du gnas pa sogs kyang dgos shing / khyad par gang bsko ba'i las la bsko ba po'i gang zag te las byed pa'i gang zag de nyid kyis brdung bar bshad pa yin la/ bcu gcig pa gaṇḍi'i rgyu tshad brdung tshul sogs gong du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid de rnams dang mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ de nyid las/ tshad de shing ngan las byas dang / /brdung na dgra mi 'byung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas yum ni brdung na ni/ /yul 'khor 'tshe ba nges par 'byung / /gtsug lag khang du dge slong rnams/ /de bzhin blo ni mi mthun dang / /nye bar brdung ba 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rnam pa du ma rtsod par 'gyur/ /mu stegs can gyi dbang 'gyur zhing / /bdud kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gdug pa'i klu ni du ma yis/ /'bras bu rnams ni nyams par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'og nas byung pa'i phan yon rnams nyams par byed pa yin la/ bcu gnyis pa gong du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid rnams dang ldan pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ rgyal po gang gi yul 'khor du/ /gaṇḍi 'di ni grags gyur pa/ /de ni dpal dang grags pa dang / /'dod pa dang ni lo legs 'byung / /pha rol gyi ni 'jig med cing / /'bras bu rnams kyang nyams mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 'byor pa yis/ /der ni bdud rnams 'dul bar 'gyur/ /dmyal ba yi dwags 'jig rten rnams/ /'jigs par 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /thams cad sangs rgyas brtag dad cing / /thams cad chos las gzhol bar 'gyur/ /der ni dge 'dun dul bar ldan/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/

/der ni nub par 'gyur ba yin/ /chos kyi rnga 'di brdungs pas ni/ /gang gi rna lam grags gyur cing / /dus gcig dag tu thos pa gang / /de rnams byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ kho bo skyes thob blo yi mig yangs pas/ /gzhung lugs gang la ltas kyang de yi don/ /rtogs pa 'di la dpyod ldan zur gnas 'ga'/ /yod na ngo mtshar gtam du mi gleng ngam/ /thos chung rnams kyis rang nyid kyis/ /ma go gzhan la mi 'dri bar/ /kun la 'ol tshod kho nas 'jug /de 'dra rang gzhan gnyis phung lags/ gsum pa gaṇḍi bskul tshul gyi grangs la dog pa'i gnas bcad pa ni/ mkhas pa chen po 'ga' zhig gi bzhed pa la/ dge 'dun rnams chos ldan gyi las so so la bsdu ba'i bye brag gaṇḍi brdung ba'i grangs la/ rgyud gsum tog gsum du brdung ba/ rgyud gsum tog gnyis su brdung ba/ rgyud gcig tog gsum du brdung ba/ rgyud gcig tog gcig tu brdung ba sogs mang du yod cing / skabs 'di'i rgyud ces pa'i don ni/ gaṇa grangs re re bzhin yang sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po la klu bdun gyis brgyan pa ltar/ gcig nas bco brgyad kyi bar je che je che dang / bcu dgu nas so drug gi rab je chung je chung du 'gro bar brdung pa gcig la rgyud ces 'jog pa yin pas de 'dra ba gcig la rgyud gcig dang / de 'dra ba gsum la rgyud gsum te brdeg thang brgya dang brgyad yin zhing / tog gsum dang bcas na brgya dang bcu gcig pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di la dpe dang 'gal ba/ rig pa dang 'gal ba/ lung dang 'gal ba dang gsum las/ dang po dpe dang 'gal ba ni/ 'o na sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po la spyir klu du ma dang / khyad par klu'i rgyal po brgyad la sogs pa rnams kyis gus par bsten cing 'dud par mtshon byed du sbrul mgos brgyan par gsungs pa'i sbrul mgo de la grangs kha 'byams yod par thal/

dpe des mtshon pa'i gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs de la kha 'byams yod pa gang zhig de gnyis dpe don du sbyar ba mdo las bshad pa ltar khyed rang yang khas len pa'i phyir/ 'dod na bdun gyis zhes grangs kha yar ba dngos su bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa rig pa dang 'gal ba ni/ dpe dang sbyar na sbrul mgo bdun gyis brgyan par gsungs pa'i sbrul mgo dbus ma de la mgo gnyis yod par thal/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma de la grangs gnyis yod pa gang zhig de gnyis dpe don du sbyar ba 'thad pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs dang po ma grub na/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma de la grangs gnyis yod par thal/ de la grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud gcig la grangs so drug tu byas tshe gaṇa grangs dbus ma ngos 'dzin rigs pa gang zhig gaṇa grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gnyis las gzhan pa 'dzin rgyu khyed kyi mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sbrul mgo bdun gyi brgyan par gsung ba'i sbrul mgo dbus ma yin na/ sbrul mgo bzhi pa yin pas khyab par thal/ sbrul mgo bdun gyis brgyan par gsung ba'i sbrul mgo dbus ma yin na/ sbrul mgo g.yas su gsum dang g.yon du gsum bzhag pa'i sbrul mgo gung ma de yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs ma yin na/ grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gang rung yin pas khyab par thal/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma yin na/ gong du grangs bcu bdun dang 'og tu grags bcu bdun bzhag ba'i grags gung ma de yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'don na song /khyab pa 'khor/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu pa gnyis/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma yin par thal/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma yod pa gang zhig de las gzhan pa khyed kyi lugs la med pa'i phyir/

'dod na song /rtags 'khor/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grags bcu dgu pa de yang / grangs bco brgyad pa yin pa thal/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gnyis char grangs bco brgyad pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gnyis chos can/ khyed grangs bco brgyad pa yin par thal/ khyed grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gang rung yin pa gang zhig khyed grangs bcu dgu pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs dang po ma grub na song /gsal ba 'khor/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa gnyis chos can/ grangs bco brgyad pa dang bcu pa gang rung yin par thal/ gaṇḍi'i rgyud gcig gi grangs dbus ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos rje/ gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched/ 'khor lo sdom pa la sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ge rnams dges par gyur cig rtsa brgyud bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas/ yi dam mnyes pa'i bzlas pa/ mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rol cha/ blo gsal mnyes pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ ha ha ha/ a rkyang nyams ldan lags so/ smras pa/ bdag gis rig pa ma sbyangs pas/ /'di la nyes pa'i cha mchis na/ /lung dang rig pa smra ba yis/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyi bzod par mdzod/ gsum pa lung dang 'gal ba ni/ sbrul mgo bdun gyis klu dbang rgyal po la brgyan pa'i sbrul mgo dbus ma mtho ba'i rnam par yod pa ltar/ gaṇa grangs bco brgyad pa ches che bar brdung dgos pas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi 'dul ba'i phyogs mthun gyi mdo'i nang tshan/ gaṇḍi'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po la/ /klu bdun gyis ni brgyan pa ltar/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas brdung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi zhal sngar nas kyang / brgya nyag brgyad do/

/zhes rgyud gsum tog gsum dang bcas pa la gaṇa grangs brgya dang nyag ma brgyad du gsungs pa ltar byams mgon gnyis pa mus rab 'byams pa mahā ka ru ṇi shrī bha drachen po thugs rje dpal bzang po'i gsungs las kyang / rgyud re la sum cu so drug tu byed pa rnams kyis ni/ klu bdun gyis brgyan pa ltar/ zhes pa'i dpe'i dmigs rnam ma chags par zad cing / brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshe'ang tog gsum dang bcas pa'i don ma nges par snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i lung rnams dang 'gal bas mi 'thad pa'i phyogs yin pas/ des na rang lugs 'thad pa'i phyogs mdo bstan bcos rnams kyi don dang mthun pa gaṇa grangs gcig nas bcu bdun bar je che je che la bco brgyad pa ches che ba/ bcu dgu nas so lnga'i bar je chung la 'gro bar brdungs pa ni rgyud ces pa'i don yin zhing de gcig la rgyud gcig dang / de 'dra ba gsum la rgyud gsum ste de rnams sdoms pas gaṇa grangs brgya dang lnga/ de dag gi steng du tog gsum dang bcas pas yongs gril rgyud gsum tog sum la brgya dang brgyad 'byung ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ gaṇḍi'i rnams bzhag nyi mi'i ming ……rta bdun rgyal po mchog /blo gsal yid kyi padmo kha 'byed 'di/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen thog mchog rnal 'byor gang / /mang du thos pa gang des legs par sbyar/ /rnal 'byor bdag la bu gcig ltar skyong ba'i/ /bstan srung gtso bo mahā kā la dang / /mthu ldan gnyen gyi mgon pa gdong bzhi pa/ /dam can pu tra dmag zor rgyal mo sogs/ /rtsal drag ldan pa rnams la 'phrin 'di zhu/ /sngags 'chad chos kyi rgyal po…kun dga' rin chen gyis yun ring du/ /dka' ba spyad nas bsgrubs pa'i dpal sa skya'i/ /sde dang bstan pa gdung brgyud chos grwar bcas/ /'di rnams yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /'di tsam dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/

/don gnyis mthar phyin bstan pa rab rgyas nas/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces gaṇḍi'i rnam gzhag legs par bshad pa rta bdun rgyal po blo gsal yid kyi padmo kha 'byed ces bya ba 'di yang / grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor grags pa blo gros/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs rtul spyi bos len pa/ sa skya pa shākyi'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lung rig smra ba rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas dbang byas te/ chu mo phag gi lo smin drug gi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /'di'i bstan pa dang bsod nams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gaṇḍi'i mdo bzhugs/ bhū bhaṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' brtsal pa/ 'byor par 'dod pas shing rnams ni/ /rab tu 'bad de brtag par bya/ /tsandan bil pa pa la sha/ /a shwad tha dang tsandan dmar/ /rgya ltar ta la keng shu ka /shing sha pa dang ta ma la/ /a smra ltar bu skyu ru ra/ /tinti sa ra a shwa ka /'di dag thams cad med na yang / /'o se las ni 'bad de bya/ /rgyal po 'bad pas thams cad du/ /'di dag med na mi bya 'o/ /tshad med shing ngan las ni byas pa dang / /brdungs na sgra ni mi 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas yum 'di brdungs na ni/ /yul 'khor 'tshe ba nges par 'byung / /gtsug lag khang du dge slong rnams/ /de bzhin blo ni mi mthun dang /

/nye bar gdung ba 'byung 'gyur zhing / /rnam pa du mar rtsod par 'gyur/ /mu stegs can gyi dbang 'gyur zhing / /bdud kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gdug pa'i klu ni du ma yis/ /'bru rnams kyang ni nyams par byed/ /rgyal khams 'dir yang sems can rnams/ /rnam par 'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gtsug lag khang yang 'jig 'gyur zhing / /chos kyang nub par 'gyur ba yin/ /bdud kyi lha rnams dge slong gi /dge 'dun shin tu ma bsdams byed/ /de ltar yang dag shes nas kyang / /legs par yongs su brtags te bya/ /tshad ni mchu ru sor tshad kyi/ /brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi nyid bya zhing / /zheng du sor drug bya ba ste/ /dpangs su yang ni gnyis bya 'o/ /sor mo'i tshigs kyi tshad dag gis/ /zur bzhir tshad ni gnyis pa yin/ /legs nyams nyid na gsal ba yin/ /rtse gnyis sbal pa'i mgo bzhin no/ /de nas rdung bar byed pa yang / /shing de nyid las bcad de bya/ /sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dag la/ /zlum zhing rtse gnyis ne'u le'i mgo /'chang gzung tshad kyang de bzhin te/ /shin tu 'jam shing rtsi mnyam par/ /gang phyir brdung gzhan dgongs pa bas/ /'og tu'ang de ni khri bya la/ /gtsug lag khang gi sgo steng ngam/ /yang na dbus ma'i steng du bya/ /de yi rab gnas bya ba ni/ /shin tu bstan pa'i chos kyi sku/ /skyed pa ma yin 'jig byed min/ /gdod nas ma bskyed pa dge ba/ /de ltar rab tu gnas byas nas/ /de ni spyan dbyer gyur pa yin/ /gaṇḍi spyan dbye byas nas kyang / /de 'og gtsug lag khang kun tu/ /klu bdun gyis ni brgyan par ltar/ /bskyed pa'i rim gyis brdung bar bya/ /de 'og dkon mchog gsum la ni/ /phyag byas nas ni brdung bya zhing / /shang tsa lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /chos kyi rnga rnams brdung bar bya/ /me tog gis ni de bzhin khrus/ /zan za nyi ma 'char nub tshe/ /dus gsum la ni lan gsum ste/ /sku khrus tshe na lan gnyis bsngags/

/blo bur gnod pa char mi 'bab/ /de bzhin 'thab dang rtsod pa dang / /glog dang gnod pa chen po dang / /gnas brtan rnams ni spyan 'dren dang / /nad dang mu ge zhi ba'i phyir/ /ma tshal rim gyis brdung bar bya/ /dge slong rnams dang dge tshul gyis/ /dus rnams rtag tu brdung ba ste/ /gso sbyong la ni gnas pa'i tshe/ /dge bsnyen gyis kyang brdung bar bya/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /klu bdun gyis ni brgyan par bya/ /rgyal po gang tshe yul 'khor du/ /gaṇḍi 'di ni grags gyur pa/ /der ni dpal dang 'grogs pa dang / /'dod pa dang ni lo legs 'gyur/ /pha rol dpung gi 'jig med cing / /'bru rnams kyang ni nyams mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 'byor pa yis/ /der ni bdud rnams 'dul bar 'gyur/ /der ni dge 'dun 'dul bar ldan/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gaṇḍi'i mdo rdzogs so// /glu 'am dbyangs bdun ni/ drang srong / sa 'dzin pa/ drug ldan pa/ lnga ldan pa/ bar ma pa/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan no// ༈ gaṇḍi'i mdo'i bsdus don rab tu gsal byed bzhugs so/ /gaṇḍi'i mdo 'di 'chad pa la/ zhus lan gnyis/ lan la don tshan bdun te/ gaṇḍi gang la bya ba'i rgyu ngos bzung ba/ rgyu de las byung ba'i gaṇḍi'i tshad dbyibs bstan pa/ tshad dbyibs de dang ldan pa'i gaṇḍi la rab gnas byed tshul/ de ltar byas pa'i gaṇḍi bzhag pa'i gnas/ gnas de ldan gyi gaṇḍi ji ltar brdung tshul/ tshul de ltar brdung ba'i gang zag dmigs te gsal ba/ de rnams kyi phan yon rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ 'byor pa'i rgyu shing ngos bzung ba/ de dag med kyang rung ba'i shing bstan pa/ de dag las gzhan pa'i shing gaṇḍi rgyu mi rung bar bstan pa/ mi rung ba de las gaṇḍi byas na nyes dmigs 'phel tshul lo/ /gnyis pa tshad dbyibs bstan pa la/ gaṇḍi'i tshad dbyi dngos dang / zhar byung gaṇa g.yog gi tshad dbyibs bstan pa gnyis/

dang po la gnyis te/ tshad bstan pa dang / dbyibs bstan pa gnyis/ gnyis pa zhar byung la'ang gnyis te/ de'i tshad dang / dbyibs bstan pa'o/ /gaṇḍi'i mdo las/ de'i tshad ni ji tsam lags/ /mdog ni ci 'dra ba lags/ bye brag ni du zhig lags/ brdung ba ni ci 'dra ba lags/ gang gi brdung bar bgyi/ gang gi tshe gang gi dus na ji srid du brdung bar bgyi/ ji ltar bzhag par bgyi/ zhes gsungs pas mdog dang / bye brag mdo ru 'chad dam snyam mo// //gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gaṇḍi'i rnam bzhag legs par bshad pa rta bdun rgyal po blo gsal yid kyi padmo kha 'byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
